[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Longest increasing subsequence II** [LC 2407 · Longest Increasing Subsequence II](https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-increasing-subsequence-ii/){difficulty="Hard"}

The predecessor of $a[i]$ is an earlier value in $[a[i] - k,\ a[i] - 1]$. That is a window on the value axis, not a prefix, so the tails array cannot see it: tails answers "any smaller value", and here a much smaller value is illegal. A segment tree of the best length at each value answers the window in $O(\log A)$.

[Solved in full in @sec-lis-p4-lis2.]{.card-link}

:::
